hotspots.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's repeated public mockery of Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni via social media memes has sparked outrage in Italy and raised concerns about transatlantic relations ahead of the NATO summit in Turkey. The personal attacks, including a meme suggesting Meloni needs a 'restraining order,' have dominated right-wing media coverage in Italy.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes diplomatic context, the personal nature of the attacks, and the potential implications for NATO unity.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility crisis
hotspots.blurb: A Paris appeals court is set to rule on Marine Le Pen's eligibility for the 2027 French presidential election following her 2025 conviction for embezzling EU parliamentary funds. The verdict could bar her from running, forcing the Rassemblement National to pivot to Jordan Bardella as their candidate.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high stakes for France's political future, the potential for a major shift in far-right leadership, and the moral implications of judicial interference in elections.

hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the scale of the protests, the AfD's growing electoral strength, and the broader implications for German democracy and European stability.
